statement: Stop embedding readinessSnapshot in replica_operations.steps_history. Entry 0 stays the operation's metadata channel and the history stays a strictly-extending transition mirror; the readiness evidence each step used is kept as a log line, not in the durable row. A row-size regression test fixes the bound for a representative multi-step operation so the observation cannot return. Deletes no row. Size S.

constraints.statement: An observation does not belong in a durable authority row (R10): the snapshot is evidence a step read, not a fact the operation owns. Every reader of steps_history is censused before the field is removed; a reader that decides on the embedded snapshot is a finding routed to its owner, not a reason to keep the field.
steps_history entry 0 is the metadata channel and the history is a strictly-extending transition mirror: no entry is dropped, truncated or capped by count.

The baseline is the 2026-11-11 lab measurement (row about 13 KB, steps_history p50 10.6 KB / p90 14.7 KB, about 80 % of each entry the embedded snapshot, about 56 KB through the ledger Raft log and CDC for a 7-step operation). The receipt names the measured size after the change on the same shape of operation.
This quest changes row content only and deletes no row; it is not held by the epic's deletion gate.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
